cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(sh3_qt_apng_fixture LANGUAGES CXX)
enable_testing()
foreach(component "" Core CoreTools Gui GuiTools Test)
  if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}/Qt6${component}Config.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT to an explicit Qt Base lib/cmake directory")
  endif()
  set(Qt6${component}_DIR "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}")
endforeach()
find_package(Qt6 6.11.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Test
  PATHS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_DATA}/oracle.json" OR NOT EXISTS "${SH3_PLUGIN_ROOT}/imageformats/libqapng.dylib")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set explicit SH3_DATA and SH3_PLUGIN_ROOT")
endif()
add_executable(qap_consumer consumer.cpp)
target_compile_features(qap_consumer PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
set_target_properties(qap_consumer PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
target_compile_options(qap_consumer PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_link_libraries(qap_consumer PRIVATE Qt6::Core Qt6::Gui)
foreach(case composition finite timing hidden static invalid movie)
  add_test(NAME qap_${case} COMMAND qap_consumer "${case}" "${SH3_DATA}" "${SH3_PLUGIN_ROOT}")
  set_tests_properties(qap_${case} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 20 ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen")
endforeach()
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/no-plugins")
add_test(NAME qap_isolation COMMAND qap_consumer isolation "${SH3_DATA}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/no-plugins")
set_tests_properties(qap_isolation PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 20 ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen")
if(SH3_PROVIDER_SOURCE)
  file(COPY "${SH3_PROVIDER_SOURCE}/tests/auto/apng/apngPlugin/"
    DESTINATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/provider-source")
  add_executable(provider_apng "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/provider-source/tst_apngplugin.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/provider-source/tst_apngplugin.qrc")
  set_target_properties(provider_apng PROPERTIES AUTOMOC ON AUTORCC ON)
  target_link_libraries(provider_apng PRIVATE Qt6::Core Qt6::Gui Qt6::Test)
  target_compile_options(provider_apng PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
  add_test(NAME provider_apng COMMAND provider_apng)
  set_tests_properties(provider_apng PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60 ENVIRONMENT
    "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen;QT_PLUGIN_PATH=${SH3_PLUGIN_ROOT}")
endif()
